names: keyboard: the arrow keys move to the nearest star in their direction, and Home, End go to the first and last star
keyboard: the stars are 1 tab stop, and each star is a named button
keyboard: Space on a star starts a line, Space on a second star draws it, and Space or Escape on the start drops it
keyboard: a line that is already drawn, or from a star to itself, is not drawn again
keyboard: Control+Z undoes the last line, Control+Shift+Z redoes it, and the buttons follow
pointer: a drag from a star to another star draws a line, and a drop on empty sky draws nothing
server: the star chart renders with no DOM
direction: Left and Right move on the sky the same way in both text directions
names: the page names the chart, each star, the drawing and the buttons
keyboard: on the page, Space draws a line, Control+Z and the Undo button undo it, and the status line reports each step
agent: an agent finds the chart and its stars, draws a line, undoes and redoes it, and cannot draw a star that is not there
